title: Wonen waar werk was 1982
authors: Voorthuizen, J.C. van, Laport, J.A., Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Geografisch en planologisch instituut (primary investigator)
contributors: Voorthuizen, j.C. Van and j.A. Laport * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Analysis of moving to a newly built area at the outskirts of Rotterdam, especially of the financial and social consequences of the people involved. Characteristics of the family / condition of present house / rent / housing benefits / energy costs / most important reason for moving / condition and costs of former home / compensations for moving / differences in rent / rent as a problem for the family budget / experiences with new living situation / surroundings of new home / connections with neighbours. Background variables: occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education
